title: Encode the accepted readiness contract in type hints
objective: Make the already-approved readiness-state contract explicit to static tooling without changing runtime behavior or public semantics.
acceptance_criteria: READINESS_STATES is annotated as tuple[ReadinessState, ...] and remains exactly ("ready", "degraded", "maintenance").
_CURRENT_READINESS is annotated as ReadinessState and remains "ready".
status() has return annotation ReadinessState and still returns "ready".
All runtime behavior from Gates 001-004 remains unchanged.
wake_test: After dispatch, the active chat must stop. A scheduled ChatGPT run will later inspect GitHub, verify the agent result, and advance state without a user message.
